**Key:** `order-hub` · **Type:** Application · **Lifecycle:** Active · **Health:** Watch · **Domain:** Customer · **Owner:** Elena Rossi · **Team:** Commerce Squad · **Classification:** Confidential · **Criticality:** Mission critical · **TIME:** Invest

## Purpose

Central order capture and orchestration for all consumer and business orders. Validates orders against the catalog, breaks them down and tracks fulfilment end to end.

## Business capabilities it supports

- Customer Order Management
- Order Capture & Validation
- Capture and Validate Order

## Depends on (upstream)

- Product Catalog (`product-catalog`)
- Service Orchestrator (`service-orchestrator`)
- Salesforce Service Cloud (`sf-service-cloud`)
- Corvina Convergent Billing (`convergent-billing`) (replaced by Corvina Cloud BSS (`cloud-bss`))
- Product Inventory (`product-inventory`)
- Notification Hub (`notification-hub`)

## Used by (downstream)

_Changing this service can affect:_

- Self-care Portal (`selfcare-portal`)
- MyAcme App (`myacme-app`)
- MyAcme Web (`myacme-web`)
- Device Webshop (`device-webshop`)
- Partner Portal (`partner-portal`)

## Data flows

- Sends data to Corvina Convergent Billing (`convergent-billing`)
- Sends data to Data Lake (`data-lake`)
- Sends data to Product Inventory (`product-inventory`)

## Interfaces

### Provides

- **Product Ordering API (TMF622)** (`product-ordering-api`): REST, Real-time, docs: https://developer.acme-telco.example/apis/product-ordering-api. Used by Self-care Portal, MyAcme App, MyAcme Web, Device Webshop, Partner Portal, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Legacy CRM
- **Order Events** (`order-events`): Event, Real-time. Used by Data Lake, Customer 360, Product Inventory, Notification Hub, Corvina Cloud BSS

### Uses

- **Product Catalog API (TMF620)** (`product-catalog-api`) from Product Catalog
- **Customer Management API (TMF629)** (`customer-management-api`) from Salesforce Service Cloud
- **Service Ordering API (TMF641)** (`service-ordering-api`) from Service Orchestrator
- **Product Inventory API (TMF637)** (`product-inventory-api`) from Product Inventory
- **Account Management API (TMF666)** (`account-management-api`) from Corvina Convergent Billing
- **Quote Management API (TMF648)** (`quote-management-api`) from Quote Builder
- **Appointment API (TMF646)** (`appointment-api`) from Field Service Manager
- **Siebel Account Web Service** (`siebel-account-ws`) from Siebel CRM 8 (⚠ phase out)
- **Notification API** (`notification-api`) from Notification Hub

## Data it manages

- Product Order: Personal data, confidential

## Technology

| Technology | Version | Radar | End of life |
|---|---|---|---|
| Java 17 | 17 | Adopt | 2027-10-31 |
| Spring Boot 4.0 | 4.0 | Adopt | 2026-12-31 |
| PostgreSQL 14 | 14 | Hold | 2026-11-12 |
| Kubernetes 1.34 | 1.34 | Adopt | 2026-10-27 |

## Standards and guardrails

- **MUST: Java services run on Java 17 or 21**: Java services run on a supported long-term-support release: Java 21 for new services, Java 17 at minimum. _(Linked directly)_
- **MUST: No new Java 8**: Java 8 must not be used for new systems or new releases of existing in-house systems. _(Applies to Java)_
- **MUST: Encrypt data in transit and at rest**: All traffic uses TLS 1.2 or later, and all stored data classified confidential or higher is encrypted with managed keys. _(Applies to every service)_
- **MUST: Customer and partner login uses Acme Identity**: Customer- and partner-facing applications authenticate users through Acme Identity (OpenID Connect). No local password stores. _(Applies to every service)_
- **MUST: Personal data stays in the EU**: Personal data of customers and employees is stored and processed only in EU regions. Support access from outside the EU needs a data protection impact assessment. _(Applies to every service)_
- **MUST: Tag cloud resources with owner and cost centre**: Every cloud resource carries the tags atrium-key, owner-team and cost-centre, so costs can be traced to applications. _(Applies to every service)_
- **SHOULD: Containers run on the shared Kubernetes platforms**: Containerised workloads run on the shared private Kubernetes platform or on Amazon EKS, not on team-managed clusters. _(Linked directly)_
- **SHOULD: Use PostgreSQL for relational data**: New systems that need a relational database use PostgreSQL (version 16 or later) from the Cloud Platform database service or Amazon RDS. _(Applies to PostgreSQL)_

## Architecture decisions

- **ADR-002: Kafka as the event backbone** (Accepted, 2022-01-20): Run a shared Event Streaming Platform on Apache Kafka with a schema registry, operated by the Integration Team.
- **ADR-003: Expose BSS capabilities through TM Forum Open APIs** (Accepted, 2023-03-14): Order Hub, Product Catalog, Product Inventory, Service Orchestrator and Trouble Ticket Manager expose TMF620, 622, 637, 641 and 621 through the API Gateway.

## Principles

- **Follow open industry standards**: Use TM Forum Open APIs, the ODA component model and other open standards where they exist.
- **Secure and private by design**: Security and privacy are designed in from the start, not added before go-live.
- **One system of record per data object**: Each data object has exactly one system of record; other systems read from it or keep copies in sync.
- **API first, events for change**: Systems share data through documented APIs and publish business events; no direct database access.
- **Cloud first**: New systems run as SaaS or on public cloud unless there is a clear reason not to.
- **Reuse before buy before build**: Use what we already have first, then buy a standard product, and only build when neither fits.

## Known risks

- Runs on Spring Boot 4.0, end of life 2026-12-31
- Runs on PostgreSQL 14, end of life 2026-11-12
- Uses PostgreSQL 14, which is on hold
- Runs on Kubernetes 1.34, end of life 2026-10-27

## Planned change

- Cloud migration wave 2 (Running, 2026-01-12 to 2027-06-30)
- Unified commerce (Planned, 2027-01-11 to 2028-12-31)

## Keeping this up to date

- Coding agents: call `check_against_standards` before proposing a design, and `propose_change` when the code changes what is described here.
- CI: keep `atrium.yaml` in the repository and run `atrium sync` on merge.
